dataList.content:
My, it has been a long while, everyone. How time flies—we haven't stood face-to-face since the manor, have we?
好久不见。自宅邸会面以来已经过了很长时间吧？
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Corridor
N公司 法庭走廊

dataList.content:
... Nelly?
……耐莉？

She is garbed in the vestments of style reminiscent of Gubo's... It appears that she has entered N Corp.'s employment.
那身服饰……与仇甫的一般无二。她是加入了N公司吗。

... When I told you to write your own tale... I didn't say you could sign on with Hermann's pack of tossers and come screwin' us over every chance you got.
……我是说过让你随心所欲地去书写自己的故事没错……但我没说让你动不动就跑到这种地方来妨碍我们啊。

What're you here to fuck up this time, anyway...?
你又来捣什么乱？

Heathcliff...
希斯克利夫……

You were— You were family! That's why I let you go, dammit! Because I wasn't blind to what living in that manor did to you. But you...! Nickin' the Golden Bough weren't enough, was it? You had to join these—! 就算如此……我也是因为把你当成家人才放你走的！你受的苦，我也不是不能理解。可你却……光是夺走了金枝还不满足吗……！

Heathcliff's bat was already in motion before the last word had left his mouth. He surged toward Nelly without the slightest hesitation...
希斯克利夫毫不犹豫地拿起球棒，向耐莉扑了过去……

... and steel flashed from Nelly's sleeve. Her knife struck the bat aside with a clean crack, and she gave ground, her composure disturbed less by fear than by tiresome consternation.
耐莉取出刀，弹开了棒球棍，像是有些为难般向后退去。

Wait. I'm here to help you, Heathcliff. Don't be rash.
等等，希斯克利夫。我是来帮你的，冷静点。
Help me? 来帮我的……？

Faust offered a small, silent nod. Heathcliff caught it and wheeled on her with murder still smoldering in his eyes.
浮士德对此疑问默默地点了点头，希斯克利夫则粗暴地开始追问。

Explain. Now.
解释下怎么回事。

... Miss Nelly is indeed a collaborator in the present operation—by way of an agreement concluded with Director Hermann's New League of Nine Littérateurs.
……耐莉小姐确实是此次计划的协助者。准确来说，是我们决定与赫尔曼董事的新九人会联手。

... Huh. No wonder you've been keeping it all hush-hush from the rest of us.
……哈。所以你才什么也没告诉我们吧？

Correct. The secrecy was only intended to alleviate the much-expected reluctance from the Sinners.
……是的。考虑到如果你们知晓的话，一定会抱有反感的情绪。

Nelly... She's betrayed me twice already. Twice!
耐莉……已经背叛了我两次。两次啊。

Even after I'd freed her—she turned round and twisted the knife! And I'm supposed to, what, trust her again? And go along with—
在我给了她自由后，她可是又背叛了我！你到底信了什么邪才让耐莉来协助……

Let us both forget all that has transpired there, dear Heathcliff. I've buried it all already.
就把过去的事给忘记吧，希斯克利夫。我已经早就全都忘记了。

Memories of that stormy, lightless old manor do nothing but knot themselves tighter around the mind.
在那狂风呼啸的昏暗宅邸里的记忆，就算去珍惜也只会扰乱心神。
"Forget"...? What do you know about forgetting, Nelly? 忘记？忘记意味着什么……你真的清楚吗？

... No, I won't forget them. Even if she's become forgotten to the world, I won't—I can't. Even if that were Cathy's wish.
……我不会忘记的。就算所有人都忘记了，我也绝对不会忘。哪怕凯茜希望自己被遗忘。

So no, I won't let anyone force me to leave the past buried, Nelly. Not you, not anyone.
所以无论是谁都别想强迫我忘掉。明白吗？

Cathy...? You've lost me again, Heathcliff. Just as you did the last time we met.
凯茜……？你又像那天一样，说了些莫名其妙的话呢。

It's... it's as though I'd been serving a ghost all those years at that abandoned manor, Heathcliff. You wouldn't know this, but... after Mister Earnshaw's death, rest his soul, the manor was left... completely unoccupied.
我……至今为止总觉得像是在侍奉幽灵一样，希斯克利夫。虽然你可能不知道，但那座宅邸……自恩肖先生去世以后，就什么也不剩了。

You weren't servin' a ghost. That manor had a rightful mistress, dammit!
……你侍奉的不是什么幽灵。那座宅邸本来就有过主人！

... I think it's high time we moved on from this subject.
……这个话题就到此打住吧。

It should be painfully apparent which party has more to lose if we let this distasteful conversation go on and on. Would you not agree, Miss Faust?
若是这个不愉快的话题继续下去，哪一边的损失更大不是很明显吗，浮士德女士？

Heathcliff, I'm sorry, but—
希斯克利夫先生……十分抱歉，但是……

... Go on, let's hear it. Just how do you intend on helping us?
……说吧。你打算怎么帮我们。

Faust had scarcely begun to move between them when Heathcliff finally yielded a step. His bat lowered one reluctant inch at a time...
希斯克利夫就像是要杀了耐莉一般瞪着她，向后慢慢退去，放下了球棍。

... though his glare remained fixed upon Nelly, as though he were recalling the old wound of betrayal.
当然……那双眼睛里依旧满是因被背叛而产生的憎恶。

My word... I made a note of this back at the manor too, but you've certainly grown soft, haven't you? The old Heathcliff would've—
在宅邸的时候我就这么觉得了，你变得温和了许多。要是从前……

Say another word. Another infuriatin' word, and your eyes just might see the "old Heathcliff" you like blatherin' on about, 'fore I knock your head clean off your shoulders.
一句……再多说一句废话试试。我就把你的脑袋打飞出去，和你说的“从前”一样。

*puff* Got more to say? Then blather away. It'll give me time to decide between S.Y.N.C. and having your L.B.
呼……还要喋喋不休下去吗？那就说吧。我会想好到底是给你折·脖还是折·肢的。

... I've rented a conference room nearby, so why don't we continue our discussion there? I'm sure we don't want to keep the other collaborators waiting.
……我租好了附近的会议室。其他协助者们都在那里等着，走吧。

Besides, this isn't exactly the best place to discuss these rather... sensitive subjects, is it?
况且在这里交谈的话，人多眼杂，不是吗？

The other collaborators being...?
其他协助者是指……

Only a handful of dear old acquaintances who, much like me, require no laborious introduction.
是和我一样，无需介绍且很乐意见到各位的协助者们。

*puff* Agreed, Bats. Can't pick and choose what to remember and what to forget.
呼……没法自由选择记住和忘却的东西这点我同意，球·棍。

We followed Nelly into some kind of conference room in a building.
我们跟随耐莉进入了某个建筑内像是会议室的地方。
dataList.place:
A Conference Hall in N Corp.
N公司某处的会议室

dataList.content:
And there, we found ourselves in the company of the "handful of dear old acquaintances"—handful of rude surprise, really—whose faces were all turned toward us.
在那里，一张张相熟却完全不想碰见的面容正盯着我们。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
While I do recall urging them to expand the hiring pool to those from my past... He is indeed a most unexpected face.
虽然我确实催他们多带点我这边的人……但这可真意外啊。

How odd... I don't recall keeping any of this information classified from you, or anyone in our team.
那个……我们不是早就应该知道了吗？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
... That fellow wasn't left out. He simply decided to be absent during the dissemination session, on account of focusing more on his research.
……这个人在商量时缺席了。说是在忙研究。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
The understanding of which I do appreciate; I wear many hats, after all.
毕竟我承担了许多工作，还请理解。

Director Hermann's plan to rescue Mister Meursault—I trust the preparations are complete?
赫尔曼董事曾说过的营救默尔索先生的计划……已经准备好了吧？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Ah, yes—the circuitous infiltration route by way of the Suicide Vending Machine. All systems in place and ready to commence, of course—it's a simple enough preparation to make.
啊，是说通过自杀贩卖机进行迂回入侵吧。已经准备万全了。也不是什么花时间的准备。

Good. We all heard that, yes? All chuffed? Then please be seated.
很好。总之情况就是这样，能请各位先落座吗？

After we were seated as per Nelly's directions...
在我们所有人跟着耐莉的引导落座后……

I leaned toward Outis in the adjoining chair. I ticked out the question that had been needling me ever since we ran into Nelly again.
我向坐在旁边的奥提斯滴答着问起了一直在意的事情。

<There's something I've got to know... What do you think they have to gain from this?>
<我有些好奇，那些人又能从中得到什么呢。>

This collaboration is most likely an outcome of a transaction rather than that of a mutually beneficial calculation, Executive Manager.
恐怕是我们通过交易支付了某种报酬吧。

A transaction that must've had something to do with the Mirror, if I am to speak based on guesswork.
推测是……与镜子相关的事情。

If they brought my past fellows into their fold by means of selling the name "League of Nine"... Miss Outis's conjecture may indeed be true.
若是他们不惜使用九人会的名字，还将我过去的朋友们带走的话……确实如奥提斯女士所言那般。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Well. It seems we need not engage in overlong elucidation—our guests are entirely self-informed as to their circumstances.
好吧，各位都是明白人。继续长篇大论就没有必要了。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
*scoff* This is hardly our first encounter. If you're still incapable of noticing something so painfully obvious... well, you wouldn't like what that says about your competence.
哈。我们也不是第一次打交道了，如果连这种事都察觉不到的话，那就有问题了。

... Bloody hell, spit it out already. What do you lot have to gain from this?
……说清楚。喂，你们帮我们，到底是在盘算些什么？

That portion of the contract remains confidential, Heathcliff.
这些还是秘密，希斯克利夫。

I can offer one reassurance, though. Unlike in our previous arrangement, we have no intention of claiming the Golden Bough. It just so happens that our goal becomes more achievable by providing you with assistance.
不过……我们并不是要像之前那样拿走金枝。不帮你们的话，我们也得不到想要的东西。

Do you seek to make us into unwitting agents of chaos, as you had in Hongyuan? Presumably after aught that can only be purloined only under the cover of tumult...
是希望我们如鸿园那时般制造混乱，然后趁机带走某物吗……

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
You and your new fellows are quite often the agents of chaos whitherever you venture, unwitting or not. Or could your presence among your fellows have sown the seeds, Yi Sang?
即便我们不如此希望，你们的所到之处不也都会产生混乱吗。还是说李箱，正因为你身处其中才会如此呢？

... Your accusation is but a gross generalization.
……但也偶有平稳之时。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Embroider the record with gentler thread if it comforts you. The reality of the matter is a truth immutable that cares not for my sympathies.
就算你再怎么找借口，事实也不会改变。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Well, moving on to the plan itself... Frankly, it's all rather simple. The place your fellow has been sent to is called Grand Magasin Sisyphe. And under normal circumstances, the only way by which entrance to that department store is permitted is the Sisyphe Penalty.
总之解释一下计划……实际上很简单。你们的同僚被送往的是名叫西西弗百货的地方。而若是不曾通过西西弗绞刑架实行西西弗刑的话，是没有办法进入西西弗百货的。

Pray, are we to be hanged, too, then?
吾等也……要被绞死吗？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Would you mind clarifying whether that query was posed in a literal sense, or if it were merely circumlocutory insinuation?
你这是字面意思，还是暗喻呢？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Depending on the nature of your query, one could say that you hit the nail on the head.
取决于你的理解方向，这个问题只对了一半。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
You would be correct if the latter were your insinuation—as you all must have gathered from observing the execution of the penalty, one must experience death to gain access to the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
如果是暗喻的话那就是正确的。看看刑罚的内容就能明白。要去往西西弗百货，就必须体验死亡。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
As luck would have it, however, word is that the Grand Magasin has recently faced some... difficulties. Word proven true, considering its current production rate of the Experience Batter.
不过，幸运的是，据说百货店如今的状态很糟糕。从经验面团的生产量来看就很明显了。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
And this has opened a crack, or a normally inaccessible avenue through which we may, in a proverbial sense, "squeeze you through."
只要手段齐全，要把你们送进那个缝隙里，对我们来说也不是什么难事。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
What luck that we are in the presence of the City's top experts at getting themselves killed.
对于你们这些每次都往地上一死的人来说，不是很简单吗？

You're not... wrong, but...
那……确实，但是……

But... Manager Bud's never died before, have they?
经理兄……不是一次都没死过吗？

Nah, but only technically. Every pain we feel when we die, Dante feels 'em too.
但丁只是没死过而已，可每次都要感受我们的那份痛苦。

Still, I can't help but worry for Dante... Pain isn't the only feeling death brings, after all...
但还是很让人担心……因为死亡除了痛苦以外，还会有许许多多的感情伴随而来……

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content: Hah, really? You're worried about death? I thought you said humans were... what was it again? "Born to die"? 哈，你连这种小事都会担心啊。人终有一死，这不就是你的道理吗？

Brother, what I said then, it was... I'm—
哥哥，我那天话里的意思……

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:
Jia Baoyu.
贾宝玉。

dataList.content:
I'd have expected you to know better now. We both know the apology waiting behind your teeth is not kindness, nor is it remorse. It is a revolting little lie.
你也差不多该懂了吧？你刚刚要说出口的无聊道歉，是多么恶心的谎言。

It appeared to me that Hong Lu could only swallow his words as he stared back at Jia Huan with a look that was as much guilt as it was desperation...
鸿璐露出了痛心与负罪感交织的表情，闭上了嘴，看向贾环……

Further infuriated by this response, however, Jia Huan opened and closed his mouth a few times as though he were trying to say something. But when he registered the circle of watching faces, he snapped his head aside emphatically without another word.
可能是被那副表情惹得更火了，贾环想说些什么……可还是环顾了一下四周便将脸扭了过去，终止了话题。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:

谈话可真是如履薄冰啊。李箱，看来你我挑选新友人的方式都错得离谱。

... I would much rather you continue this presentation than engage in pointless banter.
……还请继续说明。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:

dataList.content: Going back to the matter at hand... No, you don't actually need to die to enter. Pay closer attention to my words—you need to "experience" death to enter Sisyphe. 回归正题，你们不必真的去死。就和我刚刚说的那般，是你们必须体验死亡。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Should you fulfill that condition on your end, we have the means to circumvent the Grand Magasin Sisyphe's security measures and grant you entry.
只要有这个过程，我们就能绕过西西弗百货的安保，将你们送入百货店中。

而帮助绕开安保的物品……是巩固了赫尔曼董事在N公司地位的产品，自杀贩卖机。

<Suicide Vending Machine...>
<自杀贩卖机……>

I once read in an information booklet that introduced it as N Corp.'s, uh... newest product. While it's not as widely recognized or popular as Canned Experience, it's been spreading via word of mouth, because the service it offers is extremely thrilling... N公司的新产品……我曾经在小册子上读过其介绍。虽然与经验罐头相比是项小众的服务，但因为特别刺激所以口碑广为流传……

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
It is human nature to pathologically pursue extreme thrills, after all.
人原本就会为了刺激而疯狂，不是吗。

And I suppose that is another technology purloined from the Glass Window or the Mirror.
……那也定是由玻璃窗或镜子所作的技术。

... Now I realize anew that I am beset on all sides by revelations most disagreeable.
无论何处，我都在不断与不愿再见的面容再会。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:

哈，你啊。在这种情况下也要被个人情感牵着走吗。

……你竟说这是个人情感？那你永远也不会明了灵之哥创作玻璃窗时的心情。

It was a technology made so that those things doomed to fade away in this world might take wing freely once more. Yet vain, vulgar ones such as yourselves would peer into it only to seek out death.
那是为了让这世间的短暂消逝之物再度自由振翅而作的技术。然而如你们这般的俗人，竟要在其中寻求死亡吗。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
We merely found a purpose better suited to it. Is that not simply the way the wheel of progress turns?
我们只是找到了更为合适的目的。技术发展不是本就如此吗？

... Don't you dare—

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Now, now. How about we leave these old grudges behind us and cooperate? Withdraw that askance glare and let us work together. Surely you do not plan to spend the rest of tonight locked in a bout of words, do you?
好了好了……既然定好了要一起共事，那就暂且把个人情感放一边吧。你总不想和我们在这里待到天亮吧。

... So... we sneak in, yoink Meursault right outta that Grand Magasin or whatever, and presto. Right?

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Not quite presto. Your company's affairs have never demonstrated such affection for simple jobs. At the topmost floor of the Grand Magasin is a Golden Bough you all seem to be quite fond of collecting.
光是那样大概不会结束。在百货店最高的地方，插着一根你们喜欢的金枝。

And you're showin' us that care because...?

Unlike our first encounter, I knew they were not actively maneuvering to seize the Golden Bough for themselves...
和初次见面时不同……我知道他们并不是在主动地打金枝的主意。

总结一下就是……我们通过你们提供的自杀贩卖机潜入西西弗百货，救出5号罪人，然后平安带回金枝。

You didn't miss anything, but... there is one detail I must correct.
总结得不错，但有一处疏漏。

While it is true that the method of your entry will be unorthodox... it involves more than "minimal risk."
平安……是不一定的。

... What?!
……什么！？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content: Allow me to elaborate: your entry will escape notice. But it won't be long before they become wise to your intrusion, which is where the risks come in. 准确来说确实是潜入，不过大概很快就会被发现。

What... shall transpire, should our presence be detected?
若是被发现了……将会如何？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Feathers of N Corp. will be mobilized, of course. They will assault the Suicide Vending Machine we have chosen as your inroad to the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
N公司的员工会以你们为目标，袭击自杀贩卖机吧。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
That is when we will lend you aid.
然后我们就会在那时候帮助你们。

What's gonna happen... if we get attacked while using the Suicide Vending Machine?
要是在使用自杀贩卖机的时候被袭击……会怎么样？

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Is elaboration really necessary? It's obviously going to be something utterly catastrophic.
问题要问几次？无论怎么想都不可能平安无事吧。

<Whatever it is, sounds like a risk I don't want us to take...>
<这也太危险了……>

Our collaboration with the New League of the Nine... extends to cover such contingencies as well.
在这种情况下的协助……也已经定好了。

Lass, are you sayin' we'll have to trust these bastards to—
喂……难道说……

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content: —protect the twelve of you? Why yes, that is exactly what we'll be doing. Personally. 没错，我们会亲自保护你们，直到你们从里面出来。

... And we're, what, supposed to just put our lives in these fellas' hands?
……我们怎么才能相信你们，还把命给交出去呢？

Oh, please. Do you really think the Director would allow half-measures when her precious son is in your company?
毕竟董事重要的儿子还在这里。难道您觉得董事会敷衍了事吗？

*scoff* Isn't that a comforting thought.
哈。这话可真令人无比安心呢。

Gregor answered with a dry, incredulous snort.
格里高尔干干地嗤笑了一声。

Even if we were to look past the matter of trust... I must voice my doubts about your ability to defend us to begin with. Your performance back in Hongyuan was hardly promising.
实话说……我不对你们的武力抱有什么信任。毕竟还有鸿园那时的事情。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Hah, that's because—
哈，那个是……！

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
... You needn't worry about that. We have newly produced E.G.O gear, fresh out of lab testing, and plenty of new hires to wear them.
……完全无需担心。我们有实验完毕的新E.G.O，员工也增添了不少。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
When it really comes down to it, we'll finally put that stubborn Captain to use, too. She doesn't like how the solid earth feels? Too bad, time to get to work.
哼。真到了时候，就把船长也差遣起来吧。就算她说自己不喜欢坚硬的陆地也没办法了。

... Wh-wait. This "Captain"... Her name wouldn't happen to be Ahab, would it?
……稍、稍等一下。那个船长……难道是亚哈吗？

Deary me, you didn't know? She was here before I joined, I believe.
哎呀，您不知道吗？船长可是比我先加入呢。

... Just what exactly did you offer her? Help her hunt down the Whale?
……你们给她提出了什么条件？难道真的要去帮船长捕鲸吗？

While I cannot divulge the details of her terms... that wouldn't be the case, would it?
以何种条件签订合同是保密的……不过，应该不是那个条件吧？

... And I guess you people couldn't care less how many people her insane rabble-rousing and pigheadedness are going to get killed.
那个人……凭借着恐怖的煽动力和执念，将多少人逼向了死亡……当然，你们肯定毫不关心。

Well, Captain Ahab has her own ways of doing things.
船长有她自己的一套做事方法。

... Maybe. But if I have to watch what she's done happen all over again, right before my eyes... I don't know what I might do.
……不过，要是那些场景在我的眼前重现的话……我也无法保证自己会做出什么事情来。

Hmm. Now I'm convinced that it was a wise decision to exempt the captain from this meeting.
嗯……我觉得没让她到这里来真是太好了。

dataList.title:
N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
N公司-新九人会
dataList.content:
Now that all cards are on the table... how is it? The preparations for the infiltration are now complete. Simply say the word, and we will send you all straight to the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
所以如何呢。已经准备万全了，只要你们应允，我们很快就能将你们送去西西弗百货。

<Let's hear it. What's everyone's take?>
<大家怎么想？>

I must admit to a certain reluctance in my heart; such an alliance has been tested before, at the Tiekan Temple, to near-immediate breakdown followed by a clash.
若是坦率地说……我并不情愿。铁槛寺那时，我们最终也是合作破裂，爆发了冲突。

Are you certain they are our sole option? Frankly, I would much more readily work with the Ring and their Corridors than work with the New League of the Nine.
真的没有除此以外的手段了吗？说实话，与其与这些家伙们联手，我觉得和环指合作，在走廊里散步都要好上百倍。

Grand Magasin Sisyphe is a dimension that's fundamentally different, so it cannot be entered through a Backdoor, a Corridor, or any manner of portal. At present, we have only two viable avenues of infiltration: submit to N Corp.'s judicial process and receive the Sisyphe Penalty, or employ the New League of Nine's collaboration.
西西弗百货本质上属于不同的次元，无论从后门、走廊还是传送门……都无法进入。要么接受西西弗刑，要么向他们寻求帮助。

Seems easy enough. Let's get ourselves sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty, then. We could go to one of them Nest checkpoints and start smashin' walls and windows—
那大家一起接受西西弗刑不就好了？就像以前那样，在巢的边界大闹一场……

Alas, I would loath to commit such a heedless crime...
犯下罪行……吾并不情愿……

Don Quixote... Who do you think Heathcliff was referring to when he said "smashing walls and windows"?
堂吉诃德小姐……你觉得以前大闹一场的人是谁呢？

Ah—*cough*
咳、咳咳……

Objection chased objection around the table until the discussion began circling its own tail. Through it all, Ryōshū smoked in silence until she finally flicked a bright fleck of ash off her cigarette and severed the debate short.
在罪人们不断提出否定意见的时候，本来只是在吸烟的良秀弹了弹烟灰，开口道。

*puff* Now that I've had my turn, it's about time M.'s had his T. anyway, isn't it? Think it over when we're inside. No more idling out here.
呼……反正是轮·默了吧？与其在这里磨蹭，还不如进去再考虑。

I agree with Miss Ryōshū. I can't say I have complete faith in our company... but I do want to put my trust in Miss Faust.
我赞成良秀小姐的意见。虽然我并非完全信任公司……但我想相信浮士德小姐。
Not a huge fan of this idea either, but... I also think you two are right. I mean, it's not like we're not gonna save Meur 'cuz it's too risky, right? 我也不太情愿……但就和你俩所说的一样，首先得把默尔给救出来。

<... Right. We'll have to work with them.>
<嗯，接受帮助吧。>

Have you all come to a decision?
你们商量好了吗？

... Lead us to the Suicide Vending Machine. Let's go.
……请即刻带路吧。去自杀贩卖机所在的地方。

Sometime later…
不一会后……

<So this is it... the Suicide Vending Machine.>
<这就是……自杀贩卖机。>
